description: Capability for the overlay window (label `overlay`, created and destroyed only by the overlay thread, src-tauri/src/overlay.rs): listen to and stop listening to overlay://state, and invoke the app command overlay_ready. Nothing else: the page never shows, focuses, closes or destroys its window (T-057; least privilege, decision #45; app commands are ACL-checked per label, T-049, docs/decisions/ipc-acl.md).
